answer: Make every new identity fly a seeded voyage: over five epochs it is routed to graders drawn from disjoint stake buckets, so a sybil ring cannot grade its own members. Rewards are held like nectar in a comb and release only after all five legs pass. If two clones submit answers whose embeddings sit closer than honest pairs ever do, both lose their sparrow-sized bond and the held nectar is burned, making mass identities cost more than they earn.
